description: Submit a whole sourcing brief and let the server run it: expand the requested regions into country batches, search every batch, rank the union, gather evidence for a shortlist, and split the result into delivered profiles and screening leads. Use this instead of orchestrating dozens of search_developers and get_developer_evidence calls yourself. Returns a brief_id immediately; poll get_brief for the result. Charged once at submission (25 credits); polling is free of monthly credits. A delivered profile has a location that resolved to a single country offset and at least one inspected in-window commit in a requested skill; everything else becomes a screening lead with a reason. Public evidence can never establish commercial tenure or any closed-source work.

criteria.description: What the candidate must be. At least one language or skill is needed for evidence.

domains.description: Domain packs to assess core subject-matter work against, max 3. One of: payments, healthcare, adtech. Without a domain, every card comes back with domain tier "none".

languages.description: Programming languages the candidate must show, e.g. ['Scala'].

role.description: Role profile to score against. One of: fullstack, frontend, backend, mobile, devops, ai-engineer, ai-orchestrator, ml-engineer, data-scientist, data-engineer, security, cloud, blockchain, embedded, gamedev, ios-developer, android-developer, sre, platform-engineer, qa-engineer, solutions-architect, cto, vp-engineering, head-engineering, engineering-manager, tech-lead, product-manager, director-engineering, payments.

sectors.description: Employer sectors to favour via the employer graph, max 5. One of: adtech, ai-ml, banking, cloud, cybersecurity, ecommerce, fintech, gaming, healthtech, media, mobility, payments.

skillRecency.description: Hard eligibility filter on evidenced skill recency, same shape as search_developers.

evidence.description: Gather evidence reports for the shortlist (default true). With false the run is faster but no profile carries verified commits, so treat every result as a lead.

maxProfiles.description: Delivered profiles to aim for (1-25, default 10).

maxScreeningLeads.description: Screening leads to return alongside (0-50, default 15).

requiredCriteria.description: Every named criterion must be supported before delivery; unknowns go to screening. Requires evidence enabled. Core domain evidence requires a domain.

excludeList.description: Account-owned seen list to exclude. Snapshotted before charging; unknown or incompletely read lists are rejected. Changes after submission affect the next brief.

geography.description: Where to look, and where not to. At least one of regions or locations is required.

excludeUtcOffsets.description: Inclusive UTC offset band to exclude at the run timestamp, DST applied, e.g. { min: 0, max: 5 }. +5:30 and +5:45 sit outside a 0..5 band and stay eligible.

includeUnlocated.description: Include candidates with no stated location. They can never be delivered, only surfaced as screening leads.

locations.description: Extra countries or cities to search, max 20.

regions.description: Regions to cover, max 6. The brief expands each into countries and searches them 3 at a time so every country gets the ranker full depth, and skips countries your exclusions would discard anyway. It covers more ground than a single search_developers call can.

workHistory.description: Dated engineering history for a Scala-only brief. Use source-backed closed intervals and HTTPS source URLs; do not extrapolate stale ongoing roles. Scoped to this brief, never the public cache. Dates are as supplied, not independently verified. Does not seed discovery or prove core payments.
